newsitem.title: USA: General Electric unit FGIC buys SCA Credit.
newsitem.headline: General Electric unit FGIC buys SCA Credit.

text.p: FGIC Government Services, a GE Capital company, said Thursday it acquired SCA Credit Inc, a collection agency headquartered in Bellevue, Wash.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed, but a source familiar with the transaction said SCA was valued at between $6 million and $7 million.

SCA, which employs about 75 people and operates in California and Washington, collects overdue traffic tickets, returned checks and overdrawn credit accounts. FGIC Government Services provides financial products and services to state and local governments.

GE Capital, a subsidiary of General Electric Co, provided financing for the acquisition, leaving the company's bond insurance unit, Financial Guaranty Insurance Co, out of the funding, FGIC said in a statement.

"FGIC Government Services has identified certain services to local and state governments, such as collections, revenue management, and insurance, as the path for diversification and growth," the statement said.
FGIC said the acquisition "best uses its experience with municipal and state governments and GE Capital's knowledge and expertise in related businesses."
